name: emulation
description: Add a MITRE Caldera 5.x adversary-emulation server with the emu (CTID Adversary Emulation Plans), atomic and sandcat plugins, plus Atomic Red Team atomics and a live Sandcat agent on all domain windows machines
impact: add an emulation (Caldera) machine and, on all domain windows machines, install the Atomic Red Team PowerShell framework and deploy a Caldera Sandcat agent that checks in to the Caldera server (with Windows Defender path exclusions for the ART and sandcat directories)
